players.question: Which United legend was nicknamed 'The King'?
players.fact: Denis Law became known to United supporters simply as The King.

players.question: In which city was George Best born?
players.fact: George Best was born in Belfast, Northern Ireland.

players.question: Which United captain was famously known as 'Captain Marvel'?
players.fact: Bryan Robson's inspirational performances earned him the Captain Marvel nickname.

players.question: Which striker scored 150 competitive goals for United between 2001 and 2006?
players.fact: Ruud van Nistelrooy scored 150 goals in 219 United appearances.

players.question: Which country did centre-back Nemanja Vidić represent?
Who wore United's number 7 shirt immediately after Eric Cantona?
players.fact: David Beckham inherited the number 7 shirt after Cantona retired in 1997.

players.question: Which goalkeeper captained United in the 1999 Champions League final?
players.fact: Peter Schmeichel captained United in the final because Roy Keane was suspended.

matches.question: Who scored United's stoppage-time winner in the 4–3 Manchester derby in 2009?
matches.fact: Michael Owen's late finish settled an extraordinary derby at Old Trafford.

matches.question: Who converted the late penalty that completed United's 2019 Champions League comeback in Paris?
matches.fact: Marcus Rashford's penalty sent United through against Paris Saint-Germain.

matches.question: United came from 3–0 down to win 5–3 away to which club in 2001?
matches.fact: United scored five second-half goals in a famous comeback at Tottenham.

matches.question: Who scored United's winner against Liverpool in the 1999 FA Cup fourth round?
matches.fact: Solskjaer scored in stoppage time after Yorke had equalised.

matches.question: Who scored the only goal in United's 2008 Champions League semi-final second leg against Barcelona?
matches.fact: Paul Scholes's long-range strike sent United to the Moscow final.

matches.question: Who scored both United goals in the 1991 Cup Winners' Cup final?
matches.fact: Mark Hughes scored twice against his former club Barcelona.

matches.question: What was the score when United beat Chelsea in the 1994 FA Cup final?
matches.fact: United beat Chelsea 4–0 to complete the club's first League and FA Cup Double.

trophies.question: In which year did United win the FA Cup for the first time?
trophies.fact: United's first FA Cup triumph came against Bristol City in 1909.

trophies.question: Which team did United beat to win the 1999 Intercontinental Cup?
trophies.fact: Roy Keane scored the only goal against Palmeiras in Tokyo.

trophies.question: In which season did United win the club's first League and FA Cup Double?
trophies.fact: United completed a first Double in 1993/94.

trophies.question: Who did United beat on penalties in the 2009 League Cup final?
trophies.fact: United beat Tottenham in a Wembley penalty shootout.

trophies.question: Who were United's opponents in the 2010 League Cup final?
trophies.fact: United came from behind to defeat Aston Villa 2–1.

trophies.question: Which trophy did United lift after beating Red Star Belgrade in 1991?
trophies.fact: United won the 1991 European Super Cup 1–0 at Old Trafford.

trophies.question: Which trophy completed United's 2007/08 Double?
trophies.fact: The Champions League joined the Premier League trophy in 2007/08.

managers.question: How many English league titles did Sir Matt Busby win as United manager?
managers.fact: Busby led United to five league championships.

managers.question: Which manager signed Bryan Robson from West Bromwich Albion?
managers.fact: Ron Atkinson brought Bryan Robson to Old Trafford in 1981.

managers.question: In which season did Sir Alex Ferguson win his first league title with United?
managers.fact: The 1992/93 title ended United's 26-year wait for the league championship.

managers.question: Which two league-title seasons came under Ernest Mangnall?
managers.fact: Mangnall led United to league titles in 1908 and 1911.

managers.question: In which year was José Mourinho appointed United manager?
managers.fact: José Mourinho took charge in summer 2016.

managers.question: Who succeeded Sir Matt Busby as United manager in 1969?
managers.fact: Former United player Wilf McGuinness succeeded Busby in 1969.

managers.question: What nationality is former United manager Louis van Gaal?
managers.fact: Louis van Gaal is Dutch and managed United from 2014 to 2016.

history.question: Which ground was United's home immediately before Old Trafford?
history.fact: United moved from Bank Street in Clayton to Old Trafford in 1910.

history.question: What was the name of United's long-time training ground before Carrington?
history.fact: The Cliff in Salford served as United's training base for decades.

history.question: In which year did Old Trafford's floodlights first allow evening matches?
history.fact: Old Trafford's floodlighting was completed in 1957.

history.question: On what date did Old Trafford reopen after its post-war rebuild?
history.fact: The rebuilt stadium reopened on 24 August 1949.

history.question: Which stand was renamed the Sir Bobby Charlton Stand in 2016?
history.fact: Old Trafford's South Stand was renamed in Sir Bobby Charlton's honour.

history.question: The club was founded by workers from which industry?
history.fact: Newton Heath LYR was formed by workers from the Lancashire and Yorkshire Railway.

history.question: Which team did United play in the first match after the Munich Air Disaster?
history.fact: A patched-up United team beat Sheffield Wednesday 3–0 in the FA Cup.

culture.question: Which phrase completes the famous United refrain: 'We'll never die, we'll never die…'?
answers: Keep the red flag flying high
We'll keep the red flag flying high
United are the team for me
culture.fact: The song honours United's enduring spirit and includes 'We'll keep the red flag flying high.'

culture.question: What colour shirts did United wear in the 1968 European Cup final?
culture.fact: United lifted the 1968 European Cup wearing blue shirts.

culture.question: Which animal appears on Manchester's civic symbol echoed by the ship on United's crest?
answers: No animal—the crest uses a ship
culture.fact: The ship reflects Manchester's trading heritage; the bee is a separate civic symbol.

culture.question: Which name is commonly used for United's most vocal home end?
culture.fact: The Stretford End is synonymous with United's vocal home support.

culture.question: Which player delivered the famous 'seagulls follow the trawler' press-conference line?
culture.fact: Eric Cantona delivered the cryptic line at a 1995 press conference.

culture.question: Which colour is traditionally paired with red on United home shorts?
culture.fact: United's classic home combination is a red shirt, white shorts and dark socks.

culture.question: Which number is especially celebrated in United culture for legends including Best, Cantona, Beckham and Ronaldo?
culture.fact: United's number 7 shirt has been worn by a remarkable line of club icons.
